mapper.select: select dplfd.id, q.dates, q.pkg, q.login_user_num, q.register_user_num from (select dulr.dates, dulr.pkg, count(DISTINCT dulr.user_id) login_user_num, count(DISTINCT (CASE WHEN dulr.register_dates = dulr.dates THEN dulr.user_id END)) register_user_num from dwd_user_login_record dulr where dulr.dates = #{dates} group by dulr.dates, dulr.pkg) q LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_user_full_daily dplfd ON (dplfd.dates = q.dates and dplfd.pkg = q.pkg)
